name: Flexible Flatfoot in Children
definition: Common pediatric foot posture in which the arch flattens during standing but reconstitutes when non-weight bearing or on tiptoe.

typical: Heel valgus that corrects on tiptoe

investigations.principle: Imaging is not routinely required for typical painless flexible flatfoot.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Painful rigid or asymmetric flatfoot needs further evaluation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-vikriti phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Common pediatric foot posture in which the arch flattens during standing but reconstitutes when non-weight bearing or on tiptoe.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
